name: @playwright-intelligence/kernel
description: Browser Runtime Intelligence Platform Governance Manifest

no-legacy-imports.message: Do not import legacy subsystems. Use src/intelligence/* for canonical authorities.

single-orchestrator.message: All analyzers and inference engines must register via the IntelligenceKernel.

canonical-events.message: Use CanonicalRuntimeEvent for all telemetry payloads. No alternate event buses are permitted.

canonical-graph.message: Use ActionGraph for all semantic runtime relationships. No alternate graph systems are permitted.

canonical-state.message: Use RoleSessionManager for all runtime identities. Duplicate session ownership is forbidden.

canonical-lineage.message: Use canonical lineage types for object propagation. Duplicate lineage tracking systems are forbidden.

pure-ontology.message: Keep ontology strictly limited to semantic primitives and contracts. No execution logic allowed.

non-canonical-sidecars.message: AI interpretations must remain non-canonical sidecar annotations. They are forbidden from mutating the deterministic ActionGraph.

immutable-replay-telemetry.message: Replay telemetry is strictly immutable. No alternate replay systems are permitted.

immutable-contradictions.message: Contradictions are immutable historical entities. They can change resolution state but must never be deleted.

trust-lineage-required.message: All trust assertions must include evidence lineage references. Opaque trust assertions are forbidden.

probabilistic-hypotheses.message: Hypotheses are investigable claims, not deterministic truth. They must remain probabilistic.

explainable-prioritization.message: All prioritization scores must include contributing signals and evidence lineage. Opaque AI ranking is forbidden.

mandatory-temporal-validity.message: All derived cognition must declare temporal validity (validFrom, validTo).

mandatory-confidence.message: Every derived assertion must include confidence metadata.

no-ai-self-validation.message: AI cannot validate AI-derived evidence. Hypotheses cannot self-stabilize or self-promote to PROVEN.

deterministic-proof-supremacy.message: Deterministic replay is the sole authority for PROVEN or FALSIFIED epistemic states.

influence-lineage-required.message: All epistemic influence edges must preserve evidence lineage references to raw telemetry.

no-circular-cognition.message: Circular cognition propagation and recursive reasoning loops are explicitly prohibited.

explainable-cascades.message: Confidence decay cascades must remain explainable and bounded by propagation policies.

causality-preserves-replay.message: Cognitive causality graphs must preserve references back to the replay ActionGraph.

perturbation-requires-policy-gates.message: All replay perturbation must route through explicit TargetPolicyProfile boundaries and SafePerturbationBoundaries.

exploit-claims-require-evidence.message: All exploitability claims must remain evidence-backed with deterministic replay lineage.

artifacts-require-replay-refs.message: Investigation bundles and artifacts MUST include references back to immutable replay traces.

no-autonomous-destructive-execution.message: Autonomous destruction or fuzzing of live data is strictly prohibited. Bounded replay perturbation only.

differentials-preserve-tenant-isolation.message: All multi-role differential analysis must preserve strict tenant data isolation in its artifacts.

replay-perturbation-is-branch-only.message: Replay telemetry is strictly immutable. Perturbations only exist as explicit branches, not overwrites.

sidecar-cannot-mutate-authorities.message: AI/sidecar cognition layers cannot mutate canonical runtime state or bypass execution policy authorities.

no-uncontrolled-replay-mutation.message: No uncontrolled replay mutation or autonomous fuzzing loops. All probes require policy envelopes.

all-validation-requires-replay-refs.message: All exploit validation claims must carry deterministic replay evidence. No heuristic-only exploit claims.

runtime-execution-requires-policy-gatewa.message: All replay and perturbation execution MUST pass through the RuntimePolicyGateway. Direct adapter execution is forbidden.

canonical-evidence-decouples-adapters.message: Playwright events must not become canonical authority. All runtime evidence must be decoupled into canonical schemas.
